The purpose of these Cookies is to provide You with a more personal experience and to avoid You having to re-enter your preferences every time You use the Website. For more information about the cookies we use and your choices regarding cookies, please visit our Cookies Policy or the Cookies section of Our Privacy Policy. Where possible, We apply shorter retention periods and/or reduce identifiability by deleting, aggregating, or anonymizing data. Unless otherwise stated, the retention periods below are maximum periods (“up to”) and We may delete or anonymize data sooner when it is no longer needed for the relevant purpose. We apply different retention periods to different categories of Personal Data based on the purpose of processing and legal obligations: Usage Data is retained in accordance with the retention periods described above, and may be retained longer only where necessary for security, fraud prevention, or legal compliance. We may retain Personal Data beyond the periods stated above for different reasons: You may request information about how long We will retain Your Personal Data by contacting Us. headline: Sample Page
body: This is an example page. It’s different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this: Hi there! I’m a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin’ caught in the rain.) …or something like this: The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community. As a new WordPress user, you should go to to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

headline: वसन्तपुरमा मनाइयो गाईजात्रा (फोटो,भिडियो)
body: काठमाडौंको वसन्तपुरमा दिवंगत आफन्तको सम्झनामा गाईजात्रा मनाइएको छ। नेवार समुदायले परम्परागत बाजागाजा, भेषभूषा तथा सांस्कृतिक झाँकीसहित गाईजात्रा निकालेका छन्। वर्षभरि दिवंगत भएका आफन्तको आत्माको शान्तिको कामना गर्दै परिवारजनले गाई वा गाईको प्रतीकका रूपमा बालबालिकालाई सिँगारेर जात्रामा सहभागी गराएका छन्।

headline: Trump’s peace plan: Netanyahu calls for an end to gun rule in Gaza
body: . Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said that he has some disagreements with US President Donald Trump over the implementation of the Gaza peace plan. He said the complete disarmament of Hamas and other armed groups was necessary before the process of rebuilding Gaza could begin. According to Al Jazeera, Netanyahu commented on the Trump administration’s latest Board of Peace agreement and said that the reconstruction phase should be carried out only after Hamas is disarmed and the Gaza Strip is demilitarized. “I have some disagreements with President Trump on the recent Hamas deal, which I will not hide. Hamas must be disarmed and Gaza demilitarized before Gaza embarks on reconstruction,” Netanyahu said. He made the comments after a meeting with Nikolai Mladenov, the chief envoy of the Board of Peace. Meanwhile, the Board of Peace on the implementation of the Gaza Transition Plan has also made it clear that the process of complete withdrawal by the Israeli army from Gaza will begin only after the weapons are destroyed. The board said the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) needed the complete deactivation of all weapons in Gaza before they could withdraw from the Yellow Line. The Board of Peace has said that the immediate or partial withdrawal of Israeli troops, as some recent reports have suggested, is incorrect. It said the IDF would leave the Yellow Line only after the destruction of light weapons, heavy weapons and tunnels in line with Hamas’ commitments to mediators. “The goal is clear: the complete neutralization of all weapons in Gaza and the transition from gun rule to civilian rule,” the board said in a statement. “ The board said the transitional process would be carried out with the aim of establishing a stable civil administration in Gaza and ensuring a secure future for both the Israeli and Palestinian communities. The process will be overseen by the International Stabilization Force and the Implementation Certification Committee. The committee will include representatives from the United States and the Board of Peace. Some Israeli officials have said that Trump’s proposed Gaza roadmap does not fully reflect Israel’s official position. According to the Times of Israel, Doron Spielman, a spokesman for the Prime Minister’s Office, said that the version of the agreement was not in line with Israel’s position. He said that Israel has already sent its concerns and suggestions to the US authorities. “Disarmament means the physical surrender of its weapons to Hamas,” Spillman said. Any arrangement other than complete disarmament would allow Hamas to threaten Israel again. However, Israeli President Isaac Herzog has expressed a positive view of the Board of Peace’s initiative. He called Trump’s 20-point Gaza peace plan a “positive step” and called for the complete disarmament of Hamas. According to officials, this roadmap is based on the 20-point Gaza peace plan agreed earlier. The plan was converted into a phased implementation model after nearly eight months of negotiations following the release of the hostages and the return of their bodies. ANI
